== Summary ==

:{{pov|[[Gawyn Trakand]]}}
Gawyn is on the field near where the [[Aes Sedai]] first fought the [[Trolloc|Trollocs]]. The battle seems to be going better than expected. They have been fighting for a week at their current spot in a Kandori plain. With a sword and a shield Gawyn has positioned himself in front of [[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene's]] horse. Gawyn fights a few oncoming Trollocs while the Aes Sedai use the [[One Power]] to rip them apart. The Aes Sedai have been fighting on a rotating basis through the grueling fight and as the next pair arrives Egwene and [[Silviana Brehon|Silviana]] exit the battlefield. Gawyn knows that he is needed, but still feels as if he is being wasted. 

He and Egwene step into the command tent to greet [[Gareth Bryne]] and [[Siuan Sanche|Siuan]]. They discuss troop movements and the importance of the Aes Sedai in the battle. After discussing [[Mazrim Taim|Taim]] and the [[Dreadlords]], the pair leave so that Egwene can get some sleep. 

[[Egeanin Tamarath|Leilwin]] and [[Bayle Domon]] are waiting outside the tent. Leilwin expresses annoyance that Egwene doesn't trust her and she tells Gawyn that she will serve him if she cannot serve Egwene. Leilwin and Domon leave to bring Gawyn food as he settles to the ground and contemplates the [[Bloodknife ring|black rings]] he stole from the Seanchan assassins. Leilwin sees the ring as she returns with his food. She reacts with a hiss and tells them that the [[Empress of Seanchan|Empress]] gives them to [[Bloodknife|Bloodknives]]. The rings are dangerous and with one touch of blood the ring will become activated which will become deadly. He pockets the rings and tells himself that the way of a [[Warder]] is to protect her on the battlefield and not to ride out like some hero. Still, he does not tell Egwene about the rings. 

:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}
Rand thinks about the first time he saw a Trolloc during the [[Age of Legends]]. He weaves Fire and Air into a pack of Trollocs and [[Perrin Aybara|Perrin]]'s men raise their arms in thanks. For this fight he has disguised his face to look like that of [[Jur Grady]]. [[Lews Therin Telamon|Lews Therin]] had known of [[Aginor|Aginor's]] experiments, but was still surprised when first faced with a Trolloc. As the clouds begin to part in the sky around him, Rand realizes it's time to go. He drops the disguise and weaves Air, Fire, and Water to create a column of light stretching from him to the sky. Soldiers cheer for him. 

He [[Traveling|Travels]] back to the [[Field of Merrilor]] where [[Elmindreda Farshaw|Min]] is waiting for him along with his [[Far Dareis Mai|Maiden]] guards. She notes that he looks sad and he realizes that the time to strike at [[Shayol Ghul]] has arrived. [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin|Cadsuane]] approaches him and they discuss how Rand has been giving things away to people in preparation for his death. His expectation of death has Cadsuane worried. He replies that he has embraced inevitability. She, in return, asks if he has a gift for her. He replies that he only has gifts for those he cares about. The two remain amiable and Rand asks her to give aid to [[Aviendha]] in fighting the [[Forsaken]]. She agrees and informs him that his men in the [[Black Tower]] have freed themselves.

:{{pov|[[Al'Lan Mandragoran]]}}
The [[:Category:Malkier (people)|Malkieri]] are remembering [[Deepe Bhadar|Deepe]] and the other fallen soldiers. Lan raises his glass but remains outside the circle. Saluting the fallen has become a nightly tradition. Lan finds it encouraging that the men think of the ''[[Asha'man]]'' as one of them. 

He turns to walk through the camp taking some time to reassure [[Mandarb]] that they will rest soon. He promises that he and [[El'Nynaeve ti al'Meara Mandragoran|Nynaeve]] will take back [[Malkier]] and make it bloom again. [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu|Queen Ethenielle]]'s swordbearer, [[Baldhere]], approaches. They both find the act of doing something simple and familiar, like rubbing down their mounts, helps them think. Baldhere asks if Lan is concerned about Lord [[Agelmar Jagad|Agelmar]] and the erratic choices the man seems to be making. Lan explains away some of the mistakes that were made, but agrees to keep an eye on him. After finishing with his horse, Lan makes his way over to Lord Agelmar to study his maps and notes. The two discuss Baldhere's concerns and Lan eventually backs off saying that he trusts Agelmar's wisdom.
